opinions.title: SINOCHEM INTERNATIONAL (600500.SH)：Losses expected to narrow YoY in 1H26; proposed acquisition of Nantong Xingchen to build a high-end resin platform
opinions.opi_all: {"description":"Key takeaway The company is a leader in high-performance resins and fibers, with industry-leading production capacity for its key products, including epoxy resins, aramid fibers, and polymer additives. However, its profits were previously under pressure because its basic chemical businesses, including the C3 product chain and aromatics products, have sustained losses since 2023. As the chemical capacity expansion cycle draws to a close, the basic chemical business is expected to turn around. Meanwhile, the company plans to acquire a 100% equity interest in Nantong Xingchen to build a high-end resin materials platform, opening up long-term growth potential. Event 1） The company's proposed acquisition of a 100% equity interest in Nantong Xingchen through a share issuance, which constitutes a related-party transaction, was recently accepted for review by the Shanghai Stock Exchange. According to the announcement, the company plans to acquire a 100% equity interest in Nantong Xingchen from Bluestar Group through a share issuance for a transaction consideration of RMB2.1099bn. Upon completion of the transaction, Bluestar Group will become a shareholder of the company with a 14.35% stake, while the company will acquire a 100% equity interest in Nantong Xingchen. The company recently issued its earnings forecast for 1H26. It expects net profit attributable to shareholders of the parent company of RMB-258mn to RMB-322mn, with losses narrowing by 71% to 64% YoY, and net profit attributable to shareholders of the parent company excluding non-recurring gains and losses of RMB-283mn to RMB-353mn, with losses narrowing by 66% to 58% YoY. According to the announcement, the YoY reduction in losses in 1H26 was attributable to the following factors: ① The gross margin of the basic raw materials and intermediates segment increased by 5-11 pcts YoY due to price increases for propylene oxide and other products; ② bisphenol A prices increased in the high-performance materials segment, while aramid fiber sales volume rose by 13% YoY. ③ The gross margin of the chemical materials marketing segment increased by 0.5-6.5 pcts YoY. Quick Take Nantong Xingchen is a high-quality asset of Bluestar Group, with complementary strengths supporting the creation of a leading resin platform Nantong Xingchen primarily engages in epoxy resins and bisphenol A, PPO/PPE, PBT, and related modified engineering plastics. It currently has production capacity of 150,000 metric tons of bisphenol A, 160,000 metric tons of epoxy resins, 72,000 metric tons of PBT, 50,000 metric tons of PPE, 780 metric tons of PPO, and 56,100 metric tons of modified plastics. Its specialty PPO resin has entered the supply chains of leading copper-clad laminate manufacturers. Following the acquisition of Nantong Xingchen, the company will resolve intra-group competition within Sinochem in the epoxy resin business, increasing Sinochem International's epoxy resin production capacity to 510,000 metric tons and its supporting bisphenol A production capacity to 550,000 metric tons. On the other hand, the company can leverage Nantong Xingchen’s high-end PPO/PPE capacity to enter the electronic materials market and build a high-end resin materials platform. Electronic-grade PPO resin capacity is in short supply, and the target company is expected to benefit from simultaneous volume and price growth. PPO/PPE resin is mainly used as the substrate material for high-frequency and high-speed copper clad laminates. Due to its low dielectric loss, PPO/PPE resin has become the mainstream resin system for M6-M8 grade copper clad laminates. Currently, global PPO/PPE resin production capacity is concentrated among companies including SABIC, Asahi Kasei, Mitsubishi Gas Chemical, Nantong Xingchen, and SQ GROUP. Recently, driven by supply constraints at overseas leader SABIC and the surge in AI-related demand, the supply-demand balance for electronic-grade PPO/PPE has tightened, initiating an upward price cycle","rpt_id":478130054112235520,"title":"SINOCHEM INTERNATIONAL (600500.SH)：Losses expected to narrow YoY in 1H26; proposed acquisition of Nantong Xingchen to build a high-end resin platform"}
